content:
B"H

# COMPLETED_WORK

## Realistic 2D character system

- Added explicit ears, jaw, chin, philtrum, neck integration, brow muscles, nose form, cheek pressure, and view-aware facial structure.
- Preserved neutral reference identity separately from transient emotion, gaze, speech, and action.
- Added anatomical torso structure: neck, shoulder slope, ribcage, waist, pelvis, lapels, fabric planes, highlights, and shadows.
- Replaced symbolic straight limbs with shoulder-elbow-wrist arms and hip-knee-ankle legs.
- Added planted stops, crouches, seated bends, catches, handoffs, and phase-independent locked contact.
- Expanded garments with sleeves, coat openings, trouser seams, skirt panels, folds, hems, sway, and material shadow.

## Realistic 2D object and environment system

- Added constructed ceramic, steel, paper, glass, plastic, wood, and fabric objects.
- Added coffee machine, printer, laptop, wall clock, desk, rolling chair, cabinet, shelf, plant, mug, spoon, papers, tablet, coupon, and phone painters.
- Added deterministic static, slide, roll, fall, bounce, spin, flash, steam, print, and flutter motion states.
- Added background, midground, and foreground object layers with camera-space parallax.
- Added a realistic office set with ceiling panels, lights, windows, glass, wall panels, machine station, printer counter, cables, floor perspective, and depth.

## Dialogue and camera system

- Added speaker-anchored speech bubbles with tails, speaker bands, wrapping, safe margins, and shot-aware placement.
- Preserved title cards and timed lower-third text boxes.
- Authored eighteen shots using wide, tracking, insert, over-shoulder, close-up, extreme close-up, two-shot, group, reaction, profile, top-down, bird-eye, high angle, low angle, Dutch angle, pursuit, crane, slow push, crash zoom, handheld, whip pan, and pull-back staging.

## One-minute production

- Created `The Last Cup Before the Meeting`.
- Exact duration: 60000ms.
- Three persistent characters, four story sequences, eighteen shots, twelve spoken lines, thirty-three performance clips, twenty-two scene-object clips, two title cards, and three text boxes.
- Physical actions include running, reaching, rolling-chair blocking, rising, pocket observation, open-palm negotiation, crossed-arm refusal, pointing, tablet inspection, presenting, recoiling, bracing, covering from steam, sprinting, crouching, lunging, high and low catches, balance freeze, handoff, receiving, and final presentation.
- Object actions include machine flashing and steaming, chair rolling, papers fluttering, mug sliding and bouncing, spoon spinning, printer output, coupon sliding, and phone alerts.

## Export and verification

- Generated twelve synthesized voice tracks and 720 production frames.
- Exported exact sixty-second H.264/AAC media, preview, source plan, EDL, dialogue, performance, object, title/text, audio, probe, frame, scale, and hash evidence.
- Promoted realistic movie plan/render/persistence tests into the official repository verification chain.
- Complete repository verification exits zero.
- Forty-three touched JavaScript files pass headers, tabs, documentation, syntax, complete readback, and the 120-line limit.
